title: Chile Verde con Carne y Papas (Green Chile with Beef and Potatoes)
ldName: Chile Verde con Carne y Papas (Green Chile with Beef and Potatoes)
ldKeywords: beef chile recipe, beef chile verde, carne con chile, chile verde con papas, green chile recipe, green chile with potatoes, Mexican beef stew, Mexican chile recipe
ldIngredientsRaw: 1 1/4 teaspoons salt (divided, plus more to taste)
5  cloves garlic (divided (3 minced, 2 chopped or use a pinch of garlic powder))
4  roasted green chile peppers ((Anaheim or Hatch), peeled and stems removed)
ldInstructionsRaw: In a blender, combine green chiles, jalapeño, 1/4 teaspoon salt, 2 chopped garlic cloves (or a pinch of garlic powder), tomatoes, and tomato sauce. Pulse until chunky. Set aside.
In a large skillet, heat oil. Add beef, potatoes, and 1 teaspoon salt. Cover and cook for 10 minutes.
Add 3 minced garlic cloves and cook 2 more minutes. Stir in flour and cook 2 minutes more.
Pour in the chile-tomato blend and water. Bring to a boil. Simmer uncovered for 5–10 minutes until potatoes are tender and sauce has thickened.
